title: War in Ukraine now longer than WWI: Russia's full scale invasion reached 1,569 days
summary: 1,569 days – four years and three months: That is how long Russia's war in Ukraine has lasted. It is a milestone, surpassing the duration of World War One. The two conflicts are often compared for their brutal infantry assaults and heavy casualties. For more, FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.
